title: Test the product and stock rules

contentBlocks.body:
**Objective.** Keep inventory arithmetic independent of HTTP and persistence.

This is a real project lab in projects/inventory-desk, also available from the Projects page as a source download. Work in an isolated copy of the reference project so you can compare your change with a known baseline. Read InventoryDesk.Api/Domain.cs; InventoryDesk.Tests/DeskTests.cs before editing. Trace one request from the UI or test through the boundary that owns the behavior.

**Acceptance criteria.** Zero stock is valid, removing more than available is rejected, and adding to int.MaxValue is rejected without integer wraparound.

**Make a meaningful variation.** Add a maximum per-order reservation rule. Cover the exact maximum and one above it before changing StockRules. Write the observable expectation before editing the implementation. If the variation exposes a defect, keep the smallest failing fixture as a regression test.
Review rubric: The calculation is pure, boundaries are named in tests, and invalid actions preserve the original stock.

**Explain the boundary.** Which rules can be tested without starting an HTTP server? Describe both a successful case and a rejected or missing-data case. Compare actual output with the acceptance criteria, including status codes, persisted values, and user-visible feedback where relevant.

**Evidence to keep.** Save the focused test result, a short before/after diff, and a note explaining one tradeoff. Completing the quiz records this lesson's concepts; it does not run the companion checks or certify that the project milestone is finished.
